journey.name: BBoard: on-chain happy path
journey.description:
Every contract call bboard has that changes state: deploy a board, post a message, take it down. bboard.compact exports three circuits — `post`, `takeDown` and `publicKey` — and the third is a view circuit the app reads rather than submits, so deploy plus post plus take-down covers the whole writable surface.
The pair matters more than either half: a board that can be posted to but not taken down is broken in a way a post-only run reports as healthy, and take-down is the only call that depends on the poster's own secret key matching what the board recorded.
Preconditions this journey does NOT set up, and fails honestly without: - a debuggable build whose local.properties sets kuira.dev.seed, so there is a wallet without a passkey ceremony, and kuira.blockfrost.projectId, so PreProd answers at all; - that wallet funded on PreProd, with dust registered; - the post and takeDown proving keys installed.
The first run on a wallet with no checkpoint spends ~12 minutes syncing dust before the deploy can pay its fee. That happens once per wallet per device.
NOT YET RUN end to end — the strings come from the app's own source, not from a watched run.

actions.action: Verify the screen shows "or start a new board"
Tap the control that deploys a fresh board
Verify the screen does NOT show "Deploy failed"
Enter a message into the board's message field
Tap the control that posts the message
Verify the screen does NOT show "Post failed"
Verify the screen does NOT show "Take down failed"
Verify the screen does NOT show "POSTED"
